news_items.headline: Amed Rosario suddenly struggling against lefties at worst possible time for Yankees
news_items.summary: The Yankees brought Amed Rosario back to be a lefty killer, and through the first two months of the season, he was.

news_items.headline: Aaron Judge ‘looking forward’ to seeing how Yankees’ trade deadline unfolds as offense hits low point
news_items.summary: Aaron Judge was back in the visiting dugout at Citizens Bank Park on Sunday night and had a front-row seat to an 11-4 loss to the Phillies.

news_items.headline: Phils get needed confidence boost with rout of playoff-contending Yankees
Andruw Jones served as the Curaçao inspiration he knew he could be on path to Hall of Fame
news_items.summary: Maybe the Yankees, who still can tell you what he did in Game 1 of the 1996 World Series, and the Mets can blame one of their own for Andruw Jones.

news_items.headline: Bryson Stott homers and drives in 5 as Phillies rout Yankees 11-4 to avoid series sweep
news_items.summary: Bryson Stott homered, doubled and drove in five runs, Cristopher Sánchez pitched six solid innings and the Phillies avoided a three-game sweep.

news_items.headline: Mets bullpen continues overlooked 2026 success in win over Dodgers
news_items.summary: The Mets bullpen spared Freddy Peralta’s blushes Sunday as it produced five scoreless innings to silence the Dodgers down the stretch.

news_items.headline: Yankees sunk by pitching clunker in loss to Phillies as life without Cody Bellinger begins with dud
news_items.summary: On most nights lately, pitching has kept the Yankees in the game long enough for a struggling lineup to muster a run or two.

news_items.headline: Will Warren wretched as Yankees lose series finale in Philly
news_items.summary: After two brilliantly pitched games to open the series, the Yankees were due for a clunker.
